A.flow: A: the customer comes to the business (video or phone count as A)
A.customer: Alex M. (a parent, for Alex's son Mia, 9) · other parents and learners

services.name: Trial lesson
services.story: The main story: Mia's $35 trial lesson in Elena's Spanish 1, Sat Oct 24 at 11:00am (12 seats, 2 trial seats), paid in full when booking. A private lesson at the school ($55), a speaking club ($20) and the 10-week term ($140) are paid this way too.

services.name: Trial lesson
services.story: The same $35 trial at a school that takes nothing online: a YES books Mia's seat, and Alex pays at the desk. Adult speaking-club drop-ins can work this way too.

B.flow: B: the business goes to the customer
B.customer: Alex M. (an adult learner) · other customers

services.name: Private lesson at home
services.story: The main story: a $150 private French lesson (60 minutes) at Alex's home with Hugo. A card is saved for the $40 fee, and the $150 is charged when Hugo texts DONE.

services.name: Private lesson at home
services.story: The same $150 lesson, paid in full when booking, as some tutors ask. A $150 group class at a host's place is paid in full this way too.

services_shape: class: a seat in a set class time by language, age group and level, with a set number of seats, a few trial seats and a waitlist; each learner booked is checked in on their own. Private lessons book one teacher, at the school, at a home, or by video. A class at a host's place (a school, a company office, a library) books a teacher's time for a group
questions_before_times: who is learning: the adult themselves, or the parent's child (the age sets the class)
which language, and the level: never studied, some before, or a fluent speaker who wants a refresher
the goal: travel, school, work, or fun
at the school, by video, or at home
for a class at a host's place: how many learners, their ages, and the place
safety_stop: someone hurt or unwell right now: a hard fall, a head injury, a child who can't stand, fainting, chest pain, trouble breathing
first_steps: The pick-up list and the photo yes or no
Placement for a learner who knows some of the language
license: none for a language school or a tutor in most places; where the state's form names a license or registration, the owner adds it as an optional item. Rosie checks no license, certificate, insurance or background check
staff_skills: Spanish, French, Italian and English for speakers of other languages; conversation and exam prep; children's classes only for teachers the owner OKs for children
messages_never: a child's last name, age, learning or health notes, allergies, pick-up list or photos never go in a text; texts to the parent may use the child's first name only; texts to Sam or the staff carry no child details at all: they name the parent and the class, and link to the secure page
demo_note: Demo data for testing only. [G] = prefilled from the business's Google listing at sign-up; the owner checks each field.
